notes: Adaptive semantic LLM mode enabled via TKNT_SEMANTIC_ADAPTIVE_LLM; deterministic stage fallbacks are disabled.
Kept the canonical cluster set; no new cluster was required for this bedroom.
Tier hints favor a minimal modern bedroom with one bed, one storage anchor, and optional work/lounge support only if space surplus exists.
21.44 m2 bedroom supports a clean sleep core plus one restrained support cluster; keep circulation and window clearance dominant.
Wardrobe/dresser should survive longer than bookshelf/storage cabinet; small support items may remain if surplus is comfortable.
Work/study is plausible but secondary; lounge reading and media are weak for this brief and should drop early unless surplus is clearly high.
Active clusters normalized to required output keys.
Relation targets limited to active clusters only.
